paragraphs: Sitetracker sells one platform for planning, building, operating, and maintaining critical infrastructure. The company describes itself as a global software company that helps organizations do that work faster and more profitably. Functions listed across the lifecycle include site management, project management, financial management, and field work management.

Sitetracker describes the product as asset lifecycle management for asset owners and operators, spanning planning and development, construction, operations and maintenance, and asset management. Solutions are grouped by industry, among them digital infrastructure, data centers, construction and engineering, and real estate. Energy pages cover clean energy deployment across EV, solar, energy efficiency, DERs, and utilities. Named customers on the about page are British Telecom, KPN, Ericsson, and Chargepoint, which the company says manage millions of sites and assets.

quote.text: Managing critical infrastructure projects demands precision, efficiency, and a comprehensive approach.
